messages:
SRE Bot: [ALERT] High error rate detected for /v1/generate - sudden 5xx spike and elevated latency. Incident created (id=2311123456). Pager: oncall@sre.

Alex Kim: paging @oncall (Jamal) — confirm you got paged? :rotating_light:

Jamal Patel: got it, I'm oncall and responding. joining war room now (ops-bridge).

Alex Kim: assigning incident owner -> Jamal P. Please own comms and mitigation.

Tara O'Neill: I'll start customer impact triage. Quick summary: metrics show ~12 customers experiencing >5% failed requests in last 5m. Need list of top impacted.

Maria Gonzalez: grabbing logs and traces. Early look suggests 503s from the dedupe backend pool (dedupe-usw2). Correlating with recent kernel change?

Jamal Patel: confirmed 503s originating from dedicated pool in us-west-2. Smart routing fallback did not trigger as expected. Initiating rollback to model variant v2-quant to restore capacity.

Ops Bridge: War room created: https://admin.redwood.com/warrooms/2311123456. Bridge: +1 555 234 8765, PIN 2311.

Alex Kim: @Maria can you draft a short status page update for ops -> public? Suggest copy: "We are investigating increased error rates affecting the Generation API (us-west-2). Some customers may experience 5xx errors and elevated latency. Engineers are actively mitigating."

Maria Gonzalez: Drafted and posted to status: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2311123456 — visibility: public. Will update with ETA.

Tara O'Neill: Preparing targeted customer notification for top impacted accounts. Proposed subject: "Incident: Generation API errors in us-west-2". Body proposes degraded availability, mitigation in progress, contact support link. @Alex please review.

Alex Kim: LGTM. Please include incident id and war room link. Send to accounts A/B/C and to account reps for outreach.

Jamal Patel: rollback command running now:
```
redwood-deploy rollback --region us-west-2 --service generation --to v2-quant --force
```

SRE Bot: Deploy task queued (job_id=98765). Estimated completion ~90s.

Maria Gonzalez: Observability: error rate dropping from 18% -> 4% in last 60s after rollback start. Latency trending down.

Jamal Patel: continuing to monitor. I'll keep war room open for next 10 minutes and then handoff to night oncall. Paging confirmation: @Tara will you accept handoff at +10?

Tara O'Neill: Confirmed, will accept handoff and monitor for 30m post-handoff.

Alex Kim: Recap: owner = Jamal, war room link above, status page posted, targeted customer notifications sent. Keep short updates here every 5 minutes until fully resolved.

SRE Bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 2311123705.
